text: We’ve successfully passed our Preliminary Design Review (PDR) for the 18 satellites we're building for SemperCitiusSDA's Tracking Layer Tranche 3 (TRKT3) constellation. A big step forward in delivering advanced missile warning & defense capabilities for the U.S. and its allies.
